rows.name: W-2 · Workflow definition
rows.why: The definition uses the run page style. Each level is one Git tree screen, one row for each step. Lanes split and join. Exits are grey leaves, restarts are dashed leaves with a reason. The Outline tab shows all levels in one indented list.

sketches.caption: Outline · all levels in one list

rows.name: W-2a · Step definition
rows.why: A tap on a row opens a sheet over the dimmed tree. A step shows its executor, input, output and next moves. A child flow shows its exits, the parent map and the restart limits. A join shows its rule and one open idea.
